title: Geothermal Electricity Ordinance Extraction Schema
description: Extract regulatory requirements from county/municipal ordinances governing geothermal electricity generation facilities. Extract ONLY requirements for geothermal ELECTRICITY generation: geothermal power plants (flash steam, binary cycle, dry steam), geothermal production/injection wells for electricity, commercial geothermal energy facilities, and geothermal exploration for power generation. EXCLUDE: geothermal heat pumps (GHP), residential geothermal HVAC systems, direct-use geothermal heating/cooling, general zoning unrelated to geothermal power, and non-geothermal renewable energy.

document_applicability.description: Confirms the document scope and what was extracted vs. excluded.

applies_to_geothermal_electricity.description: Set to true if this ordinance regulates geothermal ELECTRICITY generation (power plants, commercial energy production, geothermal wells for electricity). Set to false if it only covers geothermal heat pumps (GHP), ground-source heating/cooling, or is general zoning without geothermal power provisions.

extraction_approach.description: Briefly describe what was extracted and what was excluded. State exactly what sections or language applied to geothermal electricity vs. what was filtered out.
examples: Extracted all provisions related to geothermal power plant development and operations from Chapter 10
Document does not address geothermal electricity - only contains residential GHP requirements in Section 3.5
Extracted commercial geothermal energy sections (26.138.010-090); excluded general zoning provisions for guest houses and accessory structures (26.138.100+)

relevant_sections.description: List the ordinance sections/chapters that apply to geothermal electricity exactly as cited in document (e.g., 'Chapter 10', 'Division 17', 'Sections 26.138.010-26.138.090'). Extract verbatim. Leave null if document doesn't apply to geothermal electricity.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction identification for the geothermal electricity ordinance.

state.description: State name exactly as written in document. Extract verbatim. Do not normalize or abbreviate.

county.description: County name exactly as written in document (e.g., 'Chaffee County', 'Lyon County', 'Imperial County'). Extract verbatim. Do not remove 'County' suffix.

city.description: City name exactly as written if city-level ordinance. Leave null if not applicable or not stated.

ordinanceTitle.description: Full ordinance title exactly as written in document. Must reference geothermal electricity/power/energy production. Extract verbatim. Leave null if not stated.

ordinanceNumber.description: Ordinance number exactly as written in document (e.g., '2013-33', 'Chapter 26.138'). Extract verbatim. Leave null if not stated.

ordinanceDate.description: Date enacted or last amended in YYYY-MM-DD format. Examples: 'December 10, 2013' → '2013-12-10', 'June 2024' → '2024-06-01'. If only year stated, use 'YYYY-01-01'. Leave null if not stated.

requirements.description: Array of distinct regulatory requirements. Each unique value should be a separate entry. For setbacks, create one entry per target (e.g., separate entries for 100 feet from property line, 1320 feet from residence). For time restrictions, if the same time range applies to multiple activities, you may combine them in one entry.

items.description: Individual DISTINCT requirement with structured data fields.

requirement_type.description: High-level requirement category. Choose the most specific applicable type. For time restrictions on drilling/construction activities, use 'Working hours'.

requirement_subtype.description: Specific geothermal subcategory for detailed grouping.

target.description: Standardized target that requirement applies to, references, or is measured from. For setbacks, this is what you measure FROM. For noise, where it's measured AT. For permits, what requires the permit.

target_description.description: Exact ordinance language describing the target. Preserves legal precision. If ordinance lists multiple targets, extract COMPLETE list verbatim. Do not abbreviate. Leave null if not applicable.

measurement_context.description: Additional context about how/where the measurement or requirement applies. Examples: 'Measured at property line', 'Within 300 feet of residence', 'From outer boundary', 'During nighttime operations'. Leave null if not applicable.

applicability.description: What this requirement applies to, exactly as stated in ordinance.

value.description: Numeric value exactly as stated or Yes/No. Extract numeric value without units. Examples: '1,320 feet' → 1320; '65 dBA' → 65; '7 a.m. to 7 p.m.' → '7 a.m. to 7 p.m.' (as string). Do not convert units. Leave null if not applicable.

unit.description: Unit of measurement exactly as written: 'feet', 'meters', 'dBA', 'dB(A)', 'acres', 'MW', 'days', etc. Extract verbatim. Leave null for Yes/No values or when no unit applies.

details.description: COMPLETE verbatim excerpt from ordinance combining ALL relevant information. CRITICAL: If the same requirement is mentioned in multiple sections, combine ALL details into this single field rather than creating separate entries. Include conditions, exemptions, exceptions exactly as written. Do not paraphrase.

section.description: Source section reference(s) exactly as cited. CRITICAL: If the same requirement appears in multiple sections, list ALL sections separated by commas (e.g., 'Section 10-404(2)(b), Section 10-405(3)', '§ 91703.01 G, K, P'). Do NOT create separate entries per section. Leave null only if ordinance lacks section numbering.

notes.description: ONLY use for documenting extraction uncertainties or ambiguities. Examples: 'Value inferred from range 1,000-1,500 feet', 'Text unclear on applicability to injection wells'. Do not use for summarizing clear ordinance text. Leave null for straightforward extractions.
